{{Quote|Objective was the arrest or execution of Cho'na Bene&mdash;the last of the three Jedi responsible for the Vaklin insurgency.|Oniye Namada mentions Bene in a report on the Vaklin insurgency|<ref name="Time" />}}
'''Cho'na Bene''' was a [[Myneyrsh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Bene began an [[Vaklin insurgency|insurgency]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]] along with [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|two]] [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi trainee|other]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Imperial forces led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived to confront the uprising, and Vader quickly defeated both of Bene's Jedi companions. The Myneyrsh, however, managed to evade Vader and continued to lead the [[Vaklin insurgents|insurgents]] in harassing the Imperials.

After Bene [[Ambush in the Howling Ruins|ambushed]] forces led by Vader in an area known as the [[Howling Ruins]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ordered a purge of everything Jedi-related on the planet. The purge included the destruction of a Jedi sanctuary known as the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose]], under which Bene was hiding. When Bene came out to observe the ruins, he found Vader waiting for him, and the pair [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] in a [[Duel at the Temple of Imperfect Repose|duel]]. Bene led Vader under the temple to a pocket of [[azetal]] gas, above which they [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fought]] until Vader gained the upper hand. Instead of [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Jedi, Vader left Bene amongst the toxic gas, which he inhaled large amounts of before escaping. Weakened by the gas, the Myneyrsh made his way to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vaklin Zenith]] to seek aid from the insurgents there, but before they could help him, he was shot by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I offer you compliments on your battling! Let us together turn our dead to smoke, and drink of the tranquility urn. For now there can be peace!|Bene offers Vader peace after ambushing him|<ref name="Time" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Myneyrsh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Cho'na Bene was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually [[Jedi Trials/Legends|ascending]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. He served the Order and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in their final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], before the latter was [[Declaration of a New Order|replaced]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Bene was among the few [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the betrayal of the Jedi Order and the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of many of its members by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Along with two others survivors&mdash;a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|Jedi Knight]] and his former [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|Master]]&mdash;Bene ended up on [[Vaklin]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a strongly pro-Jedi population.<ref name="TTFI" />

Bene led the other two Jedi in instigating an [[Vaklin insurgency|insurgency]] against the newly formed Empire, and many of the local population supported them, joining their cause. In response, Imperial forces quickly descended on the planet, led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and supported by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. In the drawn-out conflict that followed, Bene and the reptilian Knight witnessed Vader kill the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] on a [[Twelve-bladed satellite of Shrokaan]] by exposing him to the [[Vacuum/Legends|void]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Four [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after his former Master's death, the reptilian Knight was captured by Imperials, leaving only Bene to lead the insurgents in harassing the Imperial forces.<ref name="TTFI" />

[[File:Bene_tank.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bene ambushes Vader at the Howling Ruins.]]
Twelve [[Time/Legends|days]] after the capture of his fellow Jedi Knight, Bene set up an [[Ambush in the Howling Ruins|ambush]] for Imperial forces in the area known as the [[Howling Ruins]]. Vader, who was out searching for Bene, led a patrol into the ruins, and at approximately 0930 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] local time, the insurgent forces attacked. Armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], the insurgents fired down on the Imperials while Bene remained hidden, watching. The Jedi waited until Vader had been pinned down before emerging, killing a pair of [[clone stormtrooper]]s who were trying to aid the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. While the [[Laser/Legends|blasterfire]] kept Vader occupied, Bene took out soft targets within the patrol, destroying a [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] and a [[TX-130 Fighter Tank]]. The destruction of the [[Tank/Legends|tank]] acted as a signal for the rest of Bene's insurgents, who hurled [[pyro grenade]]s at the remaining Imperials to cover a retreat. Bene confronted Vader, complimenting him and then offering peace, before falling back himself into nearby [[Cave/Legends|caverns]],<ref name="TTFI" /> where he maintained a base beneath the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose]], a structure built to honor the Jedi Order.<ref name="TTFII" /> The Myneyrsh hoped that Vader would follow him into the dangerous caves, but around 0900 hours, the Imperials retreated, with Vader having seen through Bene's plan.<ref name="TTFI" />

Vader withdrew to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vaklin Zenith]], hoping to draw Bene out by keeping the captive Jedi Knight in the Imperial [[Command center (Vaklin)|command center]] there. The bait did not work for Bene himself, but other members of the insurgency made a [[Attack on the Imperial command center|rescue attempt]] shortly after the ambush in the Howling Ruins. The attack was unsuccessful, resulting in the deaths of the entire assault force and the captive Jedi; however, it did result in the Imperials briefly withdrawing from the surface of Vaklin to Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in orbit while the center was repaired. The locals viewed the fallen insurgents as martyrs and celebrated what they saw as an Imperial loss. This attack drove Vader to try and reduce local support for Bene and his insurgency.<ref name="TTFI" /> The Imperials began removing all traces of the Jedi Order from Vaklin, destroying commemorative statues and sites associated with the Order and even banning certain names shared with famous Jedi. The purge of Jedi culture culminated in the destruction of the Temple of Imperfect Repose, the ruins of which Bene visited after the bombardment that destroyed the temple.<ref name="TTFII" />

[[File:Bene_death.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Bene is killed while Djon watches.]]
Amongst the ruins, the Jedi found the bodies of the [[Unidentified Temple steward|Temple steward]] and a pair of ''[[Tuk'ata Nobilis]]'', a tame [[Species/Legends|breed]] of [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]], that had lived in the temple. As Bene grieved over the corpses, Vader emerged from the ruins and confronted him, revealing that the reptilian Jedi had given up his comrade's location before his death. The pair [[Duel at the Temple of Imperfect Repose|fought]] briefly until Vader disarmed the Jedi, who fled into the caverns beneath the temple, taunting Vader as the Sith followed. Bene drew Vader into an area filled with stone columns, which stood above a pocket of highly flammable [[azetal]] gas, preventing Vader from using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Vader informed the Jedi that azetal was also toxic, before the pair then [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fought]]. As they did so Bene claimed Vader's attempts to erase people's memories of the Jedi would never work so long as Vader himself obsessed over them and was a slave to his hatred. Vader then gained the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|upper hand]], but&mdash;instead of killing Bene&mdash;left him in a weakened state to try and escape from the gas-filled cave.<ref name="TTFII" />

The Jedi managed to escape from the caverns, but not before inhaling large amounts of gas, and made his way to Vaklin Zenith, where he encountered [[Djon]], a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] supporter of the insurgency. He begged Djon to help him reach one of the insurgency's safe houses, but before the Ryn could aid him, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] of the Imperial Security Bureau&mdash;disguised as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] by wearing a set of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|Stormtrooper armor]]&mdash;shot Bene and killed him. Almost two dozen civilians witnessed the Jedi's humiliating death, which was all part of Namada and Vader's plan to discredit the Jedi. Without Bene to lead them, the Vaklin insurgency began to deteriorate, and within a [[Standard week/Legends|week]], their activity had dropped to only seven percent of what it had previously been. The people of Vaklin's enthusiasm for the Imperials slowly increased as the Empire showed them the benefits of an Imperial presence. Namada recorded the entire Vaklin insurgency in a report titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="TTFII" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|KK&hellip;help&hellip;there was a safe house not far from here&hellip;is it?|Bene becomes desperate after inhaling azetal gas|<ref name="TTFII" />}}
[[File:ChonaBene-TheTyrantsFist1.png|thumb|left|150px|Bene was a member of the Mynyersh species.]]
Cho'na Bene had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and blue skin, wearing darker blue markings on his face. In battle during the insurgency, he fought using mainly hit-and-run tactics, often trying to draw his opponents into areas where he would gain the upper hand. After defeating a large portion of Vader's forces, the Mynyersh complimented [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader on his fighting prowess and offered him peace, although he fled before Vader could answer.<ref name="TTFI" />

Bene was greatly saddened by the deaths of the steward and the ''Tuk'ata Nobilis'' at the Temple of Imperfect Repose. He believed, despite Vader's attempt to erase the memory of the Jedi on Vaklin, that the Order would live on as heroes in stories. He also claimed that as long as Vader maintained his obsession with hunting Jedi, they would never be forgotten and Vader would never be content unless he showed compassion and left the surviving Jedi. After inhaling large amounts of gas, Bene became desperate and weak, begging for help and emerging in clear sight within an Imperial-controlled area.<ref name="TTFII" />

==Powers and abilities==
Bene was a capable tactician and was skilled enough in the use of lightsabers to wield three simultaneously due to his four [[Limb/Legends|arms]].<ref name="TTFI" /> He managed to hold his own for some time against Vader in a fight using lightsabers, the Force, and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]], although he was eventually overpowered.<ref name="TTFII" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Chento&mdash;hett!|Bene uses his lightsabers to destroy a tank|<ref name="Time" />}}
Bene used three blue lightsabers during combat and wore golden [[Armor/Legends|armor]] on his shoulders, wrists, and arms, as well as a [[loincloth]] and a [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]].<ref name="TTFI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cho'na Bene first appeared in [[2012]] in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 1|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 1]], which was written by [[Alexander Freed]] and illustrated by [[Marco Castiello]] and [[Andrea Chella]]. He also appeared in the next [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|issue]] of the two-part story, which was released the following [[2013|year]].
